content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Billings

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review the official PMI eligibility matrix to confirm you meet the combination of degree level and hours leading projects. Granite PM Academy can help you verify your qualifications during a brief intake conversation.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course—the formal education PMI requires. Our Billings-based cohorts run on a schedule that accommodates working professionals in the energy and construction sectors. You'll learn the PMBOK® framework, real-world case studies, and exam-focused content over 5–6 weeks.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, you'll apply directly to PMI through their online portal. Provide documentation of your education, work experience, and course completion. Pay the exam fee at the time of application. Granite PM Academy's team will guide you through each required field.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Study using Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources, practice tests, and optional one-on-one coaching sessions. The PMP® exam is offered year-round at testing centers in Billings and online. Schedule your exam window to allow adequate study time after course completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Once certified, you'll earn your PMP® credential and join a global community of project leaders. Maintain it by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) over the standard three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing workshops and courses to help you meet your PDU requirements.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
